providers.name: yahoo_chart
providers.coverage: Daily: ^GSPC from 1927, ^NDX from 1985, ^VIX from 1990, QQQ 1999+, SPY 1993+, TLT 2002+, continuous NQ/ES proxies 2000+. Intraday: 60 days of 5m, two years of 1h.
providers.limits: Unofficial endpoint; rate-limited; occasional invalid futures prints; no supported SLA.
providers.license_note: Public research use subject to Yahoo terms. Not a production exchange feed. Not for redistribution.

providers.name: fred
providers.coverage: Official series from 1986 in the committed snapshot; API supports full history and real-time vintages.
providers.limits: Latest-vintage CSV needs no key; ALFRED vintages require a free key.
providers.license_note: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis terms; cite the source.

providers.name: bls
providers.coverage: CPI, PPI, employment and wages series; multi-decade.
providers.limits: Registration key raises limits; without a key the public API is heavily throttled.

providers.name: databento
providers.coverage: CME GLBX raw-contract OHLCV, trades, MBP/MBO depending on entitlement.
providers.limits: Usage-based billing; entitlement required per dataset.
providers.license_note: Exchange fees and redistribution terms apply.

providers.name: nasdaq_data_link
providers.coverage: Dataset-dependent. Free datasets exist; premium feeds are not free.
providers.limits: Per-dataset access rights, rate limits and cost must be verified before ingestion.
providers.license_note: Do not assume premium Nasdaq feeds are free.

providers.name: bloomberg_blpapi
providers.coverage: Terminal-entitled reference, news and market data.
providers.limits: Requires an installed Terminal and licensed entitlements.
providers.license_note: No paywall bypass; no website scraping.

secrets_policy: environment variables only; never committed or logged

bls_snapshot.note: monthly period only; no release timestamp or consensus

secrets.policy: environment variables only; values are never logged or committed
